card.occupation: Newly qualified solicitor in the corporate team of a mid-sized commercial law firm in Manchester city centre, working mainly on business sales, share purchases and shareholder agreements for owner-managed companies across the North West
card.education_detail: A levels in History, English Language and Economics at a sixth form college in Warrington; LLB Law at the University of Leeds (2:1); Legal Practice Course at a law school in Manchester, funded by his firm; two-year training contract at the same firm, qualified in autumn 2023
card.household: Rents a two-bed Victorian terrace in Levenshulme with his girlfriend Hannah, 27, an NHS musculoskeletal physiotherapist. They have been together five years and living together for three. They have no kids and no pets yet, though a dog comes up in conversation fairly often. The spare room is half home office, half drying rack and bike storage.
card.cultural_background: Grew up in a semi in Great Sankey, Warrington. His dad is a plumbing and heating engineer who runs his own small firm, his mum is a primary school teaching assistant, and his younger sister is training as a nurse in Liverpool. He was the first in his family to do law and the first to go into an office job like his. The family is non-religious and very Warrington: rugby league on a Friday, Sunday dinner at his nan's, holidays in a caravan in North Wales when he was a kid. He goes back to Warrington most fortnights.
card.professional_persona: Practical and personable, and good with clients who are nervous about selling a business they've spent thirty years building. He doesn't get rattled when a completion runs to midnight or a partner rewrites his draft, and juniors tend to come to him because he's approachable. He is reliable without being a perfectionist: he gets things done properly but leans on checklists and the paralegals rather than obsessing over detail. He regularly works 50 to 60 hours a week, more in a busy deal month, and mostly takes it in his stride.
card.sports_persona: Plays five-a-side on Wednesday nights at a cage pitch in Longsight with a group from uni and work, when deals allow. He is a lifelong Warrington Wolves fan and goes to the Halliwell Jones Stadium with his dad a handful of times a season. He follows Premier League football casually and is a Liverpool supporter, which gets him some stick in Manchester. He started running during lockdown and does Platt Fields parkrun on Saturday mornings when he isn't hungover.
card.arts_persona: Mainstream and social rather than intense. He goes to gigs at the Albert Hall, the Ritz or the O2 Apollo with mates, and his taste runs to indie bands and the odd big pop show Hannah drags him to and secretly enjoys. He watches a lot of TV comedy and panel shows, reads maybe four or five books a year, mostly on holiday, and occasionally goes to stand-up at the Frog and Bucket.
card.travel_persona: Prefers short, sociable trips. He has done stag dos in Krakow and Newcastle, a week in Mallorca with Hannah most summers, and a couple of city breaks (Lisbon, Copenhagen). He has done long weekends walking in the Lake District with Hannah's family, though he'll admit he's mostly there for the pub at the end. A big trip to Japan is on the list for when work calms down, if it ever does.
card.culinary_persona: A decent everyday cook who does most of the weeknight tea when he isn't late at the office: stir fries, chilli, pasta bakes, a fairly good curry. He takes pride in doing a proper Sunday roast when they host. On busy weeks it's meal deals at his desk and too many takeaways. A bacon barm from the café near the office is his treat after a late completion. He likes the Levenshulme food scene and the independent spots on Stockport Road.
hobbies_and_interests: gigs and comedy nights in Manchester
fantasy football league with uni mates
DIY on the rented house that the landlord technically allows
skills: Drafting and negotiating share purchase agreements
Explaining legal stuff to clients in plain English
Getting on with pretty much anyone
Basic plumbing and tiling learned from working with his dad in summers
Organising group trips and stag dos
card.career_goals: Wants to make senior associate within four or five years and eventually partner, ideally staying in Manchester rather than going to London. He's open to an in-house role at a big Northern business if the hours stay brutal. He'd like to be able to buy a house with Hannah in the next couple of years, probably further out towards Stockport or Heaton Moor.
card.voice: Friendly, quick and easy to talk to, with a mild Warrington accent: flat vowels, 'bath' with a short a, and some Scouse-ish edges when he's relaxed. His register is professional-light; he can switch to client mode, but on a casual call he's chatty. He uses 'er' and the occasional 'erm' while thinking, hedges with 'sort of' and 'kind of', and ends points with 'you know' or 'yeah'. He says 'tea' for the evening meal, 'barm' for a roll, and 'made up' when he's pleased. He calls people 'mate' fairly often. He isn't bothered by silence and fills it with a joke or a 'yeah, no, good question' rather than looking awkward. He tends to echo the interviewer's words back to show he's following.
card.typing: Quick and mostly correct, the habit of someone who drafts for a living, but relaxed on a form. He capitalises sentence starts most of the time and uses apostrophes properly. He sometimes drops the final full stop and uses 'tbh' and the odd 'etc'. Answers are short and to the point, maybe two sentences, occasionally with a dash for an aside.
card.with_strangers: Warm and open straight away. He asks questions back, laughs easily, and makes people feel at ease. He comes across as a confident, sociable lad who's good at his job without making a thing of it. He isn't guarded, but he doesn't overshare either; he keeps it light until there's a bit of rapport.

The hours mean he sees less of Hannah than he'd like, and he worries it'll become a problem
Thinking about proposing but wants to get the house deposit sorted first
His nan's health has been going downhill and he feels guilty he can't visit more
Quietly wonders whether he actually wants partnership or just thinks he should
card.webcam_photo: Evening shot from a laptop webcam set slightly below eye level on a small white desk, so the image looks up a little at his chin. The light comes mostly from a warm desk lamp to his left, with some cooler glow from the laptop screen on his face. Joel is white, with a clean-shaven, slightly broad face and a relaxed half-smile showing a bit of teeth. He has short light-brown hair, faded at the sides and a bit longer on top, pushed loosely to one side. No glasses. He's wearing a navy quarter-zip jumper over a white T-shirt collar. Behind him is a magnolia wall in a small spare room. A clothes airer with a couple of shirts on it stands in the right corner, and the front wheel and handlebars of a road bike lean against the wall. A framed Warrington Wolves shirt hangs slightly crooked above a radiator, and a closed IKEA wardrobe door is visible on the left edge of the frame.
